relationships.quote: Controller sensor inputs shall include LIS-301, QI-302, LIS-501, QIS-502, TIS-602, TIS-702 and FIS-801.

facts.statement: The plant shall prepare a mixed water/NaCl batch in B3 using liquid from B1 and B2.
facts.quote: The plant shall prepare a mixed water/NaCl batch in B3 using liquid from B1 and B2.

facts.statement: The controller shall open V8 to transfer B1 liquid to B3 until LIS-301 is at least 0.13 m.
facts.quote: The controller shall open V8 to transfer B1 liquid to B3 until LIS-301 is at least 0.13 m.

facts.statement: After the B1 fill portion, the controller shall open V9 and continue charging B3 until QI-302 reaches the batch concentration target.
facts.quote: After the B1 fill portion, the controller shall open V9 and continue charging B3 until QI-302 reaches the batch concentration target.

facts.statement: The B3 target NaCl mass fraction shall be 0.080 kg/kg.
facts.quote: The B3 target NaCl mass fraction shall be 0.080 kg/kg.

facts.statement: V11 shall transfer the mixed batch from B3 to B4 until LIS-301 is below 0.01 m.
facts.quote: V11 shall transfer the mixed batch from B3 to B4 until LIS-301 is below 0.01 m.

facts.statement: The controller shall not charge B5 unless B5 is idle, defined by LIS-501 <0.01 m and V15 closed.
facts.quote: The controller shall not charge B5 unless B5 is idle, defined by LIS-501 <0.01 m and V15 closed.

facts.statement: V12 shall transfer B4 contents to B5 until LIS-501 reaches 0.18 m.
facts.quote: V12 shall transfer B4 contents to B5 until LIS-501 reaches 0.18 m.

facts.statement: B5 heating demand shall be 20,000 W when the heater actuator is enabled.
facts.quote: B5 heating demand shall be 20,000 W when the heater actuator is enabled.

facts.statement: B5 heating shall be inhibited unless FIS-801 proves condenser cooling-water flow of at least 0.10 kg/s.
facts.quote: B5 heating shall be inhibited unless FIS-801 proves condenser cooling-water flow of at least 0.10 kg/s.

facts.statement: B5 heating/evaporation shall continue until QIS-502 reaches the evaporation concentration target.
facts.quote: B5 heating/evaporation shall continue until QIS-502 reaches the evaporation concentration target.

facts.statement: The B5 evaporation concentration target shall be 0.180 kg/kg NaCl mass fraction.
facts.quote: The B5 evaporation concentration target shall be 0.180 kg/kg NaCl mass fraction.

facts.statement: After evaporation completes, the sequence shall split into parallel condensate and concentrate branches.
facts.quote: After evaporation completes, the sequence shall split into parallel condensate and concentrate branches.

facts.statement: The condensate branch shall cool B6 to 20 degC or below before return pumping.
facts.quote: The condensate branch shall cool B6 to 20 degC or below before return pumping.

facts.statement: The concentrate branch shall cool B7 to 25 degC or below before return pumping.
facts.quote: The concentrate branch shall cool B7 to 25 degC or below before return pumping.

facts.statement: The B7/P1 return branch opens V18,V23,V22,V1,V3.
facts.quote: The B7/P1 return branch opens V18,V23,V22,V1,V3.

facts.statement: The B6/P2 return branch opens V20,V24,V25,V5,V6.
facts.quote: The B6/P2 return branch opens V20,V24,V25,V5,V6.

facts.statement: The recovered condensate stream from B6 shall be returned to B1 using P2 and the B1 return valve group.
facts.quote: The recovered condensate stream from B6 shall be returned to B1 using P2 and the B1 return valve group.

facts.statement: The cooled concentrated stream from B7 shall be returned to B2 using P1 and the B2 return valve group.
facts.quote: The cooled concentrated stream from B7 shall be returned to B2 using P1 and the B2 return valve group.

facts.statement: The cycle shall not restart until both parallel return branches are complete and simulation/process time exceeds 2500 s.
facts.quote: The cycle shall not restart until both parallel return branches are complete and simulation/process time exceeds 2500 s.

facts.statement: All automated process valves shall be Boolean, discrete open/closed actuators.
facts.quote: All automated process valves shall be Boolean, discrete open/closed actuators.

facts.statement: All automated process valves shall fail closed on loss of actuator power.
facts.quote: All automated process valves shall fail closed on loss of actuator power.

facts.statement: P1 shall be inhibited when LIS-701 <=0.02 m.
facts.quote: P1 shall be inhibited when LIS-701 <=0.02 m.

facts.statement: P2 shall be inhibited when LIS-601 <=0.02 m.
facts.quote: P2 shall be inhibited when LIS-601 <=0.02 m.

facts.statement: The heater shall be inhibited when LIS-501 <0.05 m.
facts.quote: The heater shall be inhibited when LIS-501 <0.05 m.

facts.statement: The baseline integration test shall use Modelica.Media.Water.StandardWater to validate plant topology and control sequence.
facts.quote: The baseline integration test shall use Modelica.Media.Water.StandardWater to validate plant topology and control sequence.

facts.statement: The intended physical medium model shall represent a water-NaCl mixture and expose density, enthalpy, heat capacity, saturation pressure and viscosity as composition-dependent properties.
facts.quote: The intended physical medium model shall represent a water-NaCl mixture and expose density, enthalpy, heat capacity, saturation pressure and viscosity as composition-dependent properties.

facts.statement: The WaterNaCl implementation shall document the known unresolved pump-start convergence issue separately from plant functional requirements.
facts.quote: The WaterNaCl implementation shall document the known unresolved pump-start convergence issue separately from plant functional requirements.

facts.statement: Tank ports that can cross the liquid level shall use the regularized asymmetric loss-factor approach with hysteresis as the default implementation.
facts.quote: Tank ports that can cross the liquid level shall use the regularized asymmetric loss-factor approach with hysteresis as the default implementation.

facts.statement: Small junction volumes shall be inserted wherever multiple pressure-drop-only valve/pipe elements can be isolated simultaneously.
facts.quote: Small junction volumes shall be inserted wherever multiple pressure-drop-only valve/pipe elements can be isolated simultaneously.

facts.statement: Non-horizontal pipes shall include gravity pressure drop based on relative elevation.
facts.quote: Non-horizontal pipes shall include gravity pressure drop based on relative elevation.

facts.statement: Controller sensor inputs shall include LIS-301, QI-302, LIS-501, QIS-502, TIS-602, TIS-702 and FIS-801.
facts.quote: Controller sensor inputs shall include LIS-301, QI-302, LIS-501, QIS-502, TIS-602, TIS-702 and FIS-801.

facts.statement: Controller actuator outputs shall include the 15 automated valve commands, P1, P2, B5 heater, B6 cooler and B7 cooler.
facts.quote: Controller actuator outputs shall include the 15 automated valve commands, P1, P2, B5 heater, B6 cooler and B7 cooler.

facts.statement: A complete acceptance simulation shall run through at least one parallel-branch split and rejoin and continue beyond 2500 s.
facts.quote: A complete acceptance simulation shall run through at least one parallel-branch split and rejoin and continue beyond 2500 s.

facts.statement: The acceptance run shall demonstrate B3 target concentration, B5 target concentration, B6 cooling target, B7 cooling target and correct return routing.
facts.quote: The acceptance run shall demonstrate B3 target concentration, B5 target concentration, B6 cooling target, B7 cooling target and correct return routing.
